newsitem.title: USA: Mednet MPC cuts 1996 revenue forecast.
newsitem.headline: Mednet MPC cuts 1996 revenue forecast.

text.p: Mednet MPC Corp said on Tuesday that it expects to finish 1996 with revenues of approximately $100 million to $110 million, below the company's earlier forecast that revenues would be $140 million to $150 million for the year.

Mednet, which reported sales of $114.3 million in 1995, said it has experienced delays in the completion of certain new contracts that are now expected by year end and it has encountered delays in implementing a Pennsylvania contract.
Mednet said the potential contracts combined with internal growth could "materially increase revenue in 1997."
